sn22.68:1.2: ārāme. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.68:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu …pe… vihareyyanti.
sn22.68:1.4: yo kho bhikkhu anattā tatra te chando pahātabboti.
sn22.68:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn22.68:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante anattā tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:2.6: viññāṇaṃ anattā tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:2.7: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.68:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.68:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.68:3.7: viññāṇaṃ anattā tatra te chando padātabbo.
sn22.68:3.8: imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti …pe…
sn22.68:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
